verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's reading order (eyebrow, headline, subhead, CTA, then product) on a clean left edge with a big shoe. Its flaws: the peach circle has shrunk into a cut-off blob in the bottom-right corner that no longer frames the shoe, the legal line is tiny, and the lower half feels loose. B breaks the hierarchy because the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow drops below the subhead, so it reads as orphaned copy. B's circle also sits behind the headline instead of the product, a dead gap separates the shoe from the CTA pushed to the bottom, and its legal text is just as tiny.
